reviewItem.question: Does "Use DeepCopy when assigning from the runtime config Deployment template's spec by @ulucinar in https://github.com/crossplane/crossplane/pull/6538" mean a change to crd-field:crossplane|group=pkg.crossplane.io|kind=DeploymentRuntimeConfig|path=spec.deploymentTemplate.spec (behavior-changed)?

proposed.statement: Crossplane 2.0.0 now uses DeepCopy when assigning from the runtime config Deployment template's spec, so the spec assigned out of a DeploymentRuntimeConfig's deployment template is deep-copied instead of assigned directly.
